decision: Load the existing user rustup environment before checking visible cargo, then install the existing auto-update service/timer files and daemon-reload before the fresh installer's compiler starts. Reuse the same installation owner and preserve timer choice.
reason: An old running updater executes the fresh install.sh without re-executing the new updater. Copying the new unit only after compilation keeps the compiler under the obsolete MemoryHigh=3G setting. A present system cargo can also hide the already installed user rustup in systemd's older PATH. Existing environment loading and unit refresh already supply both required operations; no new toolchain or policy helper is needed.
verification: Require the exact old-budget regression RED on unchanged installer and GREEN on the move, preserve hard memory/CPU/swap limits, no timer enable/disable, learning and initial-IME-setup protections, all release gates/artifacts, and actual remote automatic 102-to-103 completion. Check-only, a mock compiler or manual deployment cannot establish automatic completion.
not_tested: At decision entry, the original installer failed the new real-fixture regression as expected. Updated source gates and real automatic application remain pending. No IME restart, delivery route, active-word ownership, local GNOME installation, model fit or all-client acceptance is authorized by this metadata refresh.
